entry.title: Temple of Hercules

buildingCutout.basis: Replace only the corresponding Amman Hercules temple control with two-centimeter numeric tolerance. Preserve all independent buildings and original native ground/water.

terrainReference.basis: Retain original pinned standard6m Mapzen hill terrain, paths/water and every independent building. Occupied column bases share a level floor just above sampled footing maxima with individually buried local masonry feet. Only the actual front portico has an authored earthen mound/graded approach; low cella/perimeter wall bottoms/tops follow native grade. No precinct-wide slab, terrain flattening, ground/water cutout or neighboring museum removal. Coarse DEM varies several meters across the main footprint and cannot resolve archaeological paving/mound sections, so foundation depths/thresholds and wall profiles remain visualization estimates.
